title: The Fence at Piazza della Civetta
synopsis: A tall fence stands around the owl square.
Behind it, a building site, a yellow helmet and a locked office.
In two days, the concrete comes.
goal: Find out whose site this is, what came here on Thursday night, and tell Sofia why the work must stop.

notes: Played as a look round (ExploreScene) of the site fence: the site rules are read, then the three helmets by the gate. Each wrong helmet shares one thing with Pia's (the crane, or the yellow): colour and picture together decide.
Replaces the work-plan order: the concrete date is already the city plan's (Case 09 final).

play.title: The Helmet on the Hook
story: Today is 8 May. Piazza della Civetta is hidden behind a tall fence.
Behind it, a crane stands still.
This is Signor Valli's building site.
play.letter:
VALLI BUILDING — SITE RULES
Everyone must wear a helmet.
Workers wear WHITE helmets with our crane.
Visitors wear YELLOW helmets with no picture.
The BOSS wears a YELLOW helmet with our crane.
Nobody opens the box room. Boss's orders!
play.question: Which helmet did the man Pia saw wear?
hints: Find the notice board on the fence and read it first.
Pia saw a yellow helmet with a crane. Check the colour AND the picture.
transition: The boss's helmet: yellow, with a crane.
Just like the helmet Pia saw on Thursday night.
Inside it, there is a name strip, torn in two.

play.title: The Box Nobody May Open
story: "I am new here," the worker whispers. "Something is strange."
He shows you the gate log, and tells you about his boss.
play.letterIntro: The worker and the gate log say:
play.letter:
THE WORKER:
"The boss keeps a heavy box in his office. Nobody may open it."

THE SITE GATE LOG:
WEDNESDAY, 8:00 AM — Bricks, 200.
THURSDAY, 11:50 PM — B. Valli. One heavy box.
FRIDAY, 7:30 AM — Sand, 3 bags.

play.title: A Message for Sofia
story: Giulia calls Director Sofia on her phone.
"I need one word to make the city listen," Sofia says.
play.letterIntro: Sofia's message and your notes say:
play.letter:
SOFIA:
"I can bring the city inspector tomorrow.
But I must tell him why the work must stop.
What is under the square?"

YOUR NOTES:
The real piece shows a room under the owl square.
The room's Latin name is BIBLIOTHECA.

objectives: Find the helmet Pia saw at Valli's site.
Find out what came on Thursday night.
intro: Piazza della Civetta is a small, quiet square.
Or it was. Now there is a tall fence all around it.
"Two more days," Livia says. "Then the concrete comes."
play.caseSummary: At Valli's site, only the boss wears a yellow helmet with a crane. Pia saw that helmet. The helmet is B. Valli's. On Thursday at 11:50 PM, Valli brought a heavy box to the site: the real piece. You told Sofia an old Roman library is under the square.

notes: Bruno is not met here: his helmet, his gate log and his work plan speak for him. He is revealed face to face in Case 11.
The worker is unnamed on purpose (not a season character).

STEP 3-14: M1 is now a look round the site fence ending in a choice of three helmets (two new pictures and the evidence helmet); the work-plan order is gone (its date is the city plan's). Talks, Discovery Moments and an ending added.
